title: Supplied Example 2 — purchasing interview
reference: Purchasing work and physical warehouse work are separate functions even when both use ERP.
No invented approval amount or cancellation authority.
Preserve correction/resubmission, supplier deviations, actual received quantity, remaining order and separation of damaged goods.
The source's contradictory warehouse/buyer advance notice must not be silently reversed.
Invoice checking and payment are explicitly outside this view; do not add them.
